newsitem.title: ITALY: Enel to reorganise into three divisions.
newsitem.headline: Enel to reorganise into three divisions.

text.p: Italian electricity group Enel said on Thursday that it would reorganise into three main operating divisions -- production, transmission and distribution.
The group, the world's second biggest electricity company, is 100 percent owned by the Italian Treasury and scheduled for privatisation in the near future. No date has been fixed.
Enel said in a statelment the three divisions would have operating autonomy and would report to the board.
The government has rejected calls in the past from the anti-trust authority to break up Enel prior to a sale.

Under the reorganisation plan, a corporate structure will also be created with 10 branches, including strategic planning and institutional and international relations. Enel said the changes were in line with European practice and "designed to improve the quality and efficiency of the service."
